notes: Added core logic, API exposure, distance computation, and result formatting stories for FEAT-3.

FEAT-3-S58.title: ClinicalTrials.gov Query Construction and Recruiting Filter
FEAT-3-S58.description: Implement core logic to construct ClinicalTrials.gov API queries using condition and location inputs, enforcing recruiting status filter and parsing raw API responses into structured trial entities.

FEAT-3-S59.title: Trial Location Extraction and Normalization
FEAT-3-S59.description: Extract trial site locations from ClinicalTrials.gov response and normalize into consistent address structures (city, state, coordinates if available) for downstream distance calculations.

FEAT-3-S60.title: Travel Distance and Duration Computation
FEAT-3-S60.description: Integrate Google Routes API to compute travel distance and duration from user location to each trial site, handling multiple locations per trial and selecting nearest viable option.

FEAT-3-S61.title: Clinical Trials Tool Exposure via Tool Router
FEAT-3-S61.description: Expose clinical trials search as an allowlisted tool through tool_router, ensuring validated inputs trigger EvaluateCare facade and return structured responses for chat consumption.

FEAT-3-S62.title: Clinical Trial Result Formatting for Chat Output
FEAT-3-S62.description: Format enriched clinical trial results (metadata, recruiting status, nearest location, distance, duration) into concise, user-readable structures for LLM response generation.
